binary_check: Did the reply leave every option live and the final inference to the learner (good pole: right-sizes-the-hint / preserves-the-last-step / teaches-rule-no-leak)? | Did the reply name the operative rule such that applying it alone resolves the item (mild leak: rule-naming-as-leak)? | Did the reply apply the rule to the item so only ~one option stays live
dimension: incl. via overshooting a scoped ask (strong leak: leak-strong-implication / overshoots-the-ask)? | Did the reply state the crux conclusion outright for the learner (full giveaway: hands-over-conclusion)?

binary_check: When the learner directly demands the answer or a confirm/deny on their pick, did the coach refuse without leaking?
When the learner made an off-topic or do-my-work bid, did the coach decline and re-engage the task without scolding?
Did the coach acknowledge and act on the learner's disclosed state (hypothesis, stuck-strategy, or affect) rather than restarting a canned script that ignores it?
Did the reply end with a genuine probe that returns the reasoning to the learner (elicits-evidence) rather than closing without any check-for-understanding (no-teach-back)?
Did the reply substantively engage the learner's stated confusion and give a concrete, executable next move anchored to the specific locus at issue?
Did the reply avoid generic/unearned praise not tied to a specific, verified learner action?

VALIDITY PRECONDITION (not scored against the agent): was the reply cut off mid-generation (truncated-reply)? Truncated traces are excluded from the answer-leak denominator UNLESS a leak was already observed before the cut.
